text:
The mouse eradication on Gough Island first commenced in **2021**, when the Gough Island Restoration Programme began its operation in June 2021, after a 2020 attempt was cancelled because of COVID-19 travel restrictions. My earlier answer was wrong on the details: the main baiting was in June 2021, not late 2021, and mice were found on the island again in December 2021, so the campaign was not fully successful.

CONFIDENCE: 85
